# 起动、风车与亚慢车工况

_Starting, Windmilling & Sub-Idle Operation_

起动与风车状态涉及正常慢车以下的工作区域，通常需要专门的部件特性和状态转换处理。NASA 的公开研究给出了向亚慢车区域扩展仿真模型的案例。

_Starting and windmilling involve operation below normal idle, where dedicated component characteristics and transition handling may be necessary. NASA provides a public example of extending a simulation into this region._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 区分起动机带转、点火与加速过程，以及未点火时由气流驱动的风车状态。

_Distinguish starter-driven rotation, ignition and acceleration from unlit rotation driven by the airflow._

- 不要把只覆盖正常慢车至大功率的模型直接外推成起动或风车模型。

_Do not assume that a model valid from normal idle to high power also represents starting or windmilling._

- 阅读亚慢车模型时，检查特性外推、状态切换、假设及验证范围。

_Check map extrapolation, transition logic, assumptions and validation coverage in a sub-idle model._
